# dsh-focus-mode
English | 简体中文
An external DeepSeek Harness preset with persistent shell sessions, direct tool calls, and TypeScrip
t program execution. No dsh source or frontend patches are required.
Compatibility: dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.3`, validated against upstream commit `22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e
3e895a2f60`. Node.js `>=24.9` is required. This repository extracts the 0.1.2 plugin implementation;
its runtime sources and bundle declaration match that implementation.
## Installation, updates, and removal
### Install from npm
The plugin is published as `dsh-focus-mode`. Use the dsh CLI of the target application with an initi
alized Web profile; users do not need to clone the repository, prepare a host checkout, or install T
ypeScript. For a profile named `web`:

Pin the version (`dsh-focus-mode@0.4.1`) when an installation must be reproducible. Replace `web` wi
th your actual profile name, such as `web-vanilla`; the command changes only the selected profile. R
estart that dsh application after installation, refresh the browser, and choose **Focus mode** in a
new session. Installation adds a preset without changing your current default.

## Behavior
- `exec_command({cmd, session_id?, cwd?, run_in_background?, new_session?})` runs a command in an Ag
ent-owned persistent shell. Working directory and environment survive successive calls: omitting `se
ssion_id` reuses this Agent's most recently used live shell, so the caller does not have to carry an
id forward. Pass `new_session:true` to start another shell; `cwd` starts one for that directory and
applies only at creation. A background command that omits `session_id` starts its own shell, becaus

e a background job owns the whole shell.
- `write_stdin({session_id, chars?, run_in_background?, clo
se?})` reads new output or sends input. A newline submits input; a standalone Ctrl-C interrupts. `cl

ose:true` closes the shell and releases its slot.
- `focus_sessions({})` lists the shells this Agent
owns with their `session_id`, running or exited state, whether a call or background job is using ea

ch one, and which shell an omitted `session_id` reuses.
- Every result is a structured value: `sessi
on_id`, `status`, `created`, `send`, `wait`, `text`, and `incomplete`, plus `exit_code`, `signal`, o
r `job_id` when they apply. Direct calls render the same `[session …]` header as before; `run_code`
programs read the fields instead of parsing that header. `created` tells a new shell apart from a re

used one, and an unknown `session_id` names the live shells.
- `run_code` uses the upstream PTC exec
utor. Available plugin tools enter both direct schemas and the program SDK through the host registry
; the executor has no tool-name allowlist. Host scope, step admission, restrictions, approvals, guar

ds, cancellation, and logging remain authoritative.
- Background jobs monitor a whole shell until it
exits or closes. `job_kill` closes that shell, and a shell has at most one monitor. `maxBackgroundJ
obsPerAgent` (default 2) bounds how many jobs one Agent runs at a time, so background work cannot co
nsume every shell. A job completes when the shell exits or is closed, not when an individual command

finishes: shell liveness or a settled send does **not** establish that a command finished.
[该节后续省略]
## Configuration
The plugin defaults to four persistent shell sessions per Agent and two background jobs per Agent. S
ession count is configurable from 1 to 64. `reuseMostRecentSession` keeps calls that omit `session_i
d` on one shell; turn it off to require an explicit `session_id` or `new_session` on every call. The
upstream jobs registry has a separate concurrent-job limit. The 16-session/16-job example overrides
eam jobs registry has a separate concurrent-job limit. The 16-session/16-job example overrides both:

`--patch` applies to that launch. For a permanent override, merge the example's two rows into the pr
ofile's `cordis.patch.yml`, preserving other settings and existing fields on the `jobs` row.
[该节后续省略]
## Development
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- Compatibility is pinned to one pre-stable host baseline; upgrades require revalidation.
- Shell se
ssions live in memory and do not survive a process restart. Exited sessions count toward the quota u

ntil closed. Agent or plugin teardown closes owned terminals.
- The scrollback interface lacks a mon
otonic byte cursor. Identical output replacing an entire retained window cannot always be distinguis

hed; already discarded bytes cannot be recovered.
- The profile must provide the upstream Web host c
apabilities and a PTC runtime. This bundle does not launch a server or configure a model/network pro

vider.
- Full browser UI, real providers, and Windows/macOS behavior were not covered by the Linux k
eyless suite. The preset name and description do not use the host's built-in preset translation tabl
less suite. The preset name and description do not use the host's built-in preset translation table.
